title: Phase 1 - Add compact Operations / Control Center summary section

new_section.location: Top of Controls tab, before Limited Automation Control and detailed controls.

active_symbol_card.market_allowed: shown from policy context when available

best_candidate_card.best_candidate: shown from latest scanner result when available

readiness_safety_card.next_safe_action: WAIT / RUN_SCANNER / RUN_PREFLIGHT / LIVE_CLOSE_LIMIT_ALLOWED / VERIFY_LAST_SUBMIT / DO_NOT_BACKFILL / DO_NOT_DUPLICATE_SUBMIT / STOP_AND_DIAGNOSE

last_lifecycle_card.last_action_id: shown when lifecycle report exists or latest automation action loads read-only
last_lifecycle_card.warning_shown: CANCELED_NO_FILL displays: Submitted but canceled with no fill. Do not backfill.

payload_preview.payload_shown: shown when latest preflight has enqueue_payload_preview

summary: Controls tab now starts with a compact Operations / Control Center summary using existing session data only. It surfaces active symbol policy, best scanner candidate, readiness/safety, next safe action, last lifecycle, payload preview, and raw JSON expanders while leaving all existing detailed sections in place.
